description: Debtor Sen & Traders declared insolvent by court; entire trade debt balance ₹18,000 written off as unrecoverable Bad Debt
narration: Being unrecoverable trade debtor balance written off to Bad Debts Account
explanation: Irrecoverable Customer Balance: Debit Bad Debts Expense A/c Dr ₹18,000 (Loss), Credit Sundry Debtor Asset A/c Cr ₹18,000 (removing debtor asset).

description: Debtor M/s Roy & Co declared bankrupt; received 40 paise in a rupee (40%) ₹10,000 in cash in full settlement of ₹25,000 debt; remaining 60% (₹15,000) written off as Bad Debt
narration: Being 40% dividend received from insolvent debtor and remaining 60% written off as Bad Debt
explanation: Compound Insolvency Settlement: Debit Cash Asset A/c Dr ₹10,000, Debit Bad Debts Expense A/c Dr ₹15,000, Credit Debtor Asset A/c Cr ₹25,000.

description: Unexpectedly received cash ₹8,000 from former debtor Sen & Traders whose debt of ₹18,000 was written off as bad debt last year
narration: Being cash received against debt previously written off as bad debt
explanation: Subsequent Debt Recovery: Debit Cash Asset A/c Dr ₹8,000, Credit Bad Debts Recovered Account Cr ₹8,000 (Gain/Income to firm; NEVER credited to debtor account).

description: Created 5% Provision for Doubtful Debts on total ending Sundry Debtors ₹2,00,000 (5% of ₹2,00,000 = ₹10,000) at financial year end 31-Mar-2027
narration: Being 5% provision for doubtful debts created on ending debtors under prudence principle
explanation: Prudence Provision: Debit Profit & Loss A/c Dr ₹10,000 (charging expense), Credit Provision for Doubtful Debts Reserve A/c Cr ₹10,000 (Contra-Asset deduction from Debtors in Balance Sheet).

description: Increased Provision for Doubtful Debts from existing ₹10,000 to new required 5% provision ₹14,000 on debtors ₹2,80,000 (Additional Provision = ₹4,000)
narration: Being additional provision created to maintain 5% provision on increased debtor balance
explanation: Increasing Provision Reserve: Debit Profit & Loss A/c Dr ₹4,000, Credit Provision for Doubtful Debts A/c Cr ₹4,000.

description: Reduced Provision for Doubtful Debts from existing ₹14,000 to new required provision ₹9,000 on debtors ₹1,80,000 (Excess Provision ₹5,000 credited back to P&L)
narration: Being excess provision for doubtful debts transferred back to Profit & Loss Account
explanation: Releasing Excess Reserve: Debit Provision for Doubtful Debts A/c Dr ₹5,000 (reducing reserve), Credit Profit & Loss A/c Cr ₹5,000 (credited as income/gain).

description: Debtor Alpha Agencies declared insolvent; unrecoverable balance ₹12,000 written off to Bad Debts Account
narration: Being unrecoverable balance written off to Bad Debts Account
explanation: Bad Debt Write-Off: Debit Bad Debts Expense A/c ₹12,000, Credit Sundry Debtor A/c ₹12,000.

description: Received SBI Bank cheque ₹5,000 from former debtor M/s Roy & Co against bad debt written off in prior period
narration: Being cheque received against debt previously written off as bad debt
explanation: Bad Debt Recovery: Debit SBI Bank Asset A/c ₹5,000, Credit Bad Debts Recovered Income A/c ₹5,000.

description: Transferred total bad debts expense (₹18k + ₹15k + ₹12k = ₹45,000) to Profit & Loss Account at year end
narration: Being total annual bad debts expense transferred to Profit & Loss Account
explanation: Closing Entry: Debit Profit & Loss A/c ₹45,000, Credit Bad Debts Expense A/c ₹45,000.

description: Maintained 6% Provision for Doubtful Debts on ending debtors ₹1,50,000 (Required Provision = ₹9,000)
narration: Being 6% provision for doubtful debts created on ending trade debtors
explanation: Prudence Provision Entry: Debit Profit & Loss A/c ₹9,000, Credit Provision for Doubtful Debts A/c ₹9,000.
